name: kaseya-vsa-mcp
description: Every VSA 10 API endpoint, plus a local fleet database that answers patch, health, and software questions across all your clients offline.

kaseya_vsa_server.title: KASEYA_VSA_SERVER
kaseya_vsa_server.description: Your VSA 10 instance host name, for example yourcompany.vsax.net (no https://).

kaseya_vsa_token_id.title: KASEYA_VSA_TOKEN_ID
kaseya_vsa_token_id.description: VSA 10 API token ID (Administration > Configuration > API Access).

kaseya_vsa_token_secret.title: KASEYA_VSA_TOKEN_SECRET
kaseya_vsa_token_secret.description: VSA 10 API token secret, shown once when the token is created.

kaseya_vsa_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
kaseya_vsa_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

kaseya_vsa_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
kaseya_vsa_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

kaseya_vsa_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
kaseya_vsa_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

kaseya_vsa_base_url.title: VSA 10 API base URL (optional)
kaseya_vsa_base_url.description: Optional. The full VSA 10 API base URL, https://<server>/api/v3, instead of KASEYA_VSA_SERVER. Leave blank to build it from KASEYA_VSA_SERVER.

kaseya_vsa_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
kaseya_vsa_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on VSA 10 requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
